runs.content: Elevance was bought on its Q3 beat-and-raise (adj. EPS $6.99 vs ~$4.70, FY26 guide ≥$29, ≥12% 2027 growth) at ~15x forward after a 1.4% dip on the print; managed care aligns with Burry's longs. BBW was exited as a capacity trim at $23.36 (−8.68%, −$87; weakest position, below its 52-week low). No stop/T1/T2 triggers. Turso CLI writes worked; 3 raw-SQL fixes (COP T1, MCK/AMAT dates) are still blocked. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,541 (+3.14% on $81,000).

Zoetis was bought at ~13x trailing earnings (vs a ~30x history) after a 45% fall; it is basing above its 52-week low with ~$2B FCF and a 2.7% yield, and is a direct Burry long (Q3 report 11-05). GEV was exited as a capacity trim at $890.33 (−8.18%, −$82; weakest position). No stop/T1/T2 triggers. Turso CLI writes worked and cleared most of the 10-19 backlog; 3 raw-SQL fixes (COP T1, MCK/AMAT dates) are still blocked. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,543 (+3.18% on $80,000).
